name: Rosa Fox
source:
The primary maid and cook of Hotel Dusk. She is talkative, bossy, loves gossiping, and finding information about the guests at the hotel. 

[Based on the [url=https://cing.fandom.com/wiki/Rosa_Fox]wiki[/url]]
